title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025

qualification: Enrolled in a CS degree, proficiency in C++, Java, or Python, and knowledge of data structures and algorithms.
description: Work on core technology products, collaborate with engineering teams, and solve complex real-world computing problems at Google.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2025

salary: Fully Funded (Full tuition, £20,000 annual stipend, airfare)
qualification: Outstanding academic record, leadership potential, and commitment to improving the lives of others.
description: Prestigious international scholarship program providing full funding for postgraduate study at the University of Cambridge.

title: Remote Frontend Engineer

qualification: 3+ years of experience with JavaScript, Vue.js, HTML/CSS, and modern frontend tools.
description: Develop and maintain accessible UI components, collaborate asynchronously, and contribute to an open-source DevOps platform.

title: Associate Data Scientist

qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, or quantitative field.
description: Build statistical models, analyze product usage datasets, and apply machine learning algorithms to improve user experience.

title: Imagine Cup 2025

salary: Up to $100,000 USD Grand Prize + Azure Credits
qualification: Teams of 1-4 students building innovative technical solutions utilizing Microsoft Azure and AI technologies.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science

qualification: Beginner level; requires access to a computer and internet connection.
